Bill.BriefDescription: Providing criminal penalties for false statements in voters' pamphlets.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to voters' pamphlets; adding a new section tochapter 29A.84 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.84 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person who knowingly makes or allows to be made on his orher behalf a false statement of material fact in a voters' pamphlet isguilty of a gross misdemeanor punishable under RCW 9A.20.021. (2) For purposes of this section, a "false statement of materialfact" includes a statement that would lead a person of ordinaryintelligence to reasonably understand the statement as conveyinginformation that is false. (3) The public disclosure commission may impose a civil penalty notto exceed five thousand dollars for each violation under subsection (1)of this section.
